source: user-provided I7 PDF and physical workbook text; source-specific paragraphs and neighboring text

cases.verbatim_question: Tuburile şi ţevile metalice sau din material plastic din instalaţiile electrice de j.t. se instalează:

verbatim_A_B_C.C: aparent sau îngropat, în anumite condiţii

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Numai aparent excludes explicitly permitted embedded/underground installation.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Numai îngropat excludes exposed/visible installation explicitly permitted.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: Both apparent and embedded modes are permitted, subject to building, conduit and fire/environmental conditions.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Before §5.2.12.1 general conduit/tube requirements; after §5.2.12.2.2 limits structural resistance installations.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Allowable mode varies by material and location; not all tubes are allowed under every local condition.

cases.verbatim_question: Amplasarea instalaţiilor electrice de joasă tensiune pe trasee comune cu acelea ale altor instalaţii sau utilaje care ar putea să le pericliteze în funcţionare normală sau în caz de avarie:

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Unqualified prohibition stronger than the actual 'must avoid' rule; a separately specified dielectric-fibre exception exists.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: The norm literally requires avoidance where other installation may endanger the electric route in normal or fault operation.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: This is a normative obligation, not a designer's unrestricted discretion.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Prior §3.0.3.2 gives arrangement of parallel services; following §3.0.3.5 prohibits certain routes under condensing equipment except protected execution.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: 2023 amendment explicitly excludes fully dielectric optical communication cables from blanket avoidance, so 'interzisă' is wrong.

cases.verbatim_question: Dispozitivele pentru suspendarea corpurilor de iluminat (cârlige, bolţuri, dibluri, etc) se aleg astfel încât să suporte fără deformări:

verbatim_A_B_C.B: de 5 ori greutatea corpului de iluminat, dar nu mai puţin de 10 kg
verbatim_A_B_C.C: de 3 ori greutatea corpului de iluminat utilizat

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Over 5 kg is not enough for heavier fixtures and omits 5x factor.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Supports 5 times fixture mass with absolute floor of 10 kg without deformation.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: 3 times weight is below the prescribed factor.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Prior §5.4.20 describes power-factor correction in discharge lamps; after §5.4.22 regulates phase-wire placement for lighting switches.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: This is minimum suspension SUPPORT CAPACITY, not weight or placement height of fixture.

cases.verbatim_question: Este obligatorie protecţia la suprasarcini pentru:

verbatim_A_B_C.A: instalaţii din încăperi din categoriile celor cu risc de incendiu sau de explozie

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Normal exceptions to overload protection do NOT apply to locations at risk of fire or explosion; thus these require appropriate overload protection under exact scope.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Control circuits may fall under the source exemption from overload devices; not categorically required under this choice.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: Signalling circuits likewise may fall under exception, not universally obligatory.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Earlier §4.3.2.1 addresses where devices are placed; following §4.3.2.3 imposes special IT network constraints and §4.3.2.4 allows no-trip in certain dangerous operation situations.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Do not apply exemption for control/signalling in risk-of-explosion rooms; exact installation hazard overrides generic circuit-class examples.

cases.verbatim_question: Pe circuitele secundare ale transformatoarelor de curent:

verbatim_A_B_C.A: este obligatoriu să se prevadă protecţia la suprasarcină
verbatim_A_B_C.B: este obligatoriu să se prevadă protecţia la scurcircuit
verbatim_A_B_C.C: se permite renunţarea la protecţia la scurtcircuit

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Section 4.3.2.4.1 recommends NO overload protection on current-transformer secondary circuits if unexpected disconnection risks safety; A universally mandatory is false.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Norm gives explicit exceptions to normal overcurrent devices for some sensitive measurement circuits; B universally mandatory is overbroad.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: Section 4.3.3.1.3.1 permits omission of short-circuit protection on CERTAIN measurement circuits only if short-circuit risk is minimized and routing avoids combustibles. A CT secondary can be such a circuit, but the exact CT secondary object is not explicitly named in that short-circuit exception: the broad original C needs a grade-specific scope confirmation.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Section 4.3.2.4.1 before short-circuit chapter lists CT secondaries as overload no-trip examples; following §4.3.3.1.3.1 covers conditional short-circuit no-trip on some measuring circuits.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Explicit CT-secondary exemption applies to overload interruption, not blanket all short circuits. No automatic scored C.

cases.verbatim_question: Pe circuitele secundare ale transformatoarelor de curent:

verbatim_A_B_C.A: este obligatoriu să se prevadă protecţia la suprasarcină
verbatim_A_B_C.B: se recomandă să nu se prevadă protecţia la suprasarcina
verbatim_A_B_C.C: este obligatoriu să se prevadă protecţia la scurcircuit

reasoning_A_B_C.A: The cited rule recommends avoiding unexpected overload trips on CT secondary measurement circuits, not obligatory overload protection.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Directly matches recommended lack of overload tripping where interruption can cause danger; CT secondary is in listed examples.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: A universal obligation for short-circuit protection is contradicted by narrowly permitted exception for measurement circuits, with conditions.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Before §4.3.2.2 lists overload exemptions in special circuits; §4.3.3.1.3.1 afterward gives different short-circuit conditions.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Do not confuse permission not to trip overload with general right to omit all short-circuit protections.

cases.verbatim_question: Legarea conductoarelor din cupru la aparate, maşini, elemente metalice fixe, se face    (de regulă) prin strângere mecanică cu şuruburi în cazul conductoarelor cu secţiuni mai mici sau egale cu:

reasoning_A_B_C.A: 16mm² is where direct/special terminal attachment, not the upper limit of 'de regulă' screw tightening.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Mechanical screw tightening generally prescribed at ≤10mm² copper, direct/special terminals for ≥16mm².
reasoning_A_B_C.C: 6mm² is below the maximum 10mm² and misses intended threshold.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: §5.2.6.9–10 before discuss Cu-Al special joints and busbar connections; §5.2.6.12 afterward sets robust PE joints.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Text says 'de regulă', and has an intermediate 10–16 mm² choice unspecified here; don't overgeneralize installation workmanship.

cases.verbatim_question:
În instalaţiile electrice pentru şantiere de construcţii şi de demolare, rezistenţa de dispersie a prizei de pământ şi rezistenţa conductoarelor de protecţie până la
receptor trebuie să fie de

reasoning_A_B_C.A: A maximum of 1Ω is more restrictive but not the specified question's maximum (4Ω).
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Source requires resistance no more than 4Ω, not at least 4Ω.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: 4Ω maximum directly matches the site earthing and PE-to-receiver resistance rule.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Prior §7.4.33 connects local and general site PE networks; following §7.4.35 further requires local grounding electrodes and network maximum 4Ω.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Specific construction/demolition sites only; must also meet automatic-disconnection conditions of §4.1.

cases.verbatim_question: Conform normativului I-7-2011, alimentarea de securitate la un consumator este o alimentare prevăzută pentru menţinerea în funcţiune a echipamentelor şi instalaţiilor electrice importante pentru:

verbatim_A_B_C.A: sănătatea şi securitatea persoanelor şi animalelor domestice
verbatim_A_B_C.B: continuarea activității productive a principalelor instalații tehnologice ale consumatorului respectiv
verbatim_A_B_C.C: continuarea activității productive a instalațiilor tehnologice ale consumatorului respectiv

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Health and safety of people and domestic animals is explicitly in definition.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Ordinary production continuity is a stand-by/back-up supply goal, not the defining safety service.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: Likewise ordinary technological production is not by itself the safety-service scope.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Immediately preceding definition describes standby supply for continuity of non-safety functions; following description adds avoidance of serious environmental/equipment consequences beyond human/animal safety.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: The I7 safety definition also permits other specified purposes; A is one true purpose without a 'numai' exclusive claim.

cases.verbatim_question: La bateriile de condensatoare de joasă tensiune fracționabile cu trepte comutabile se prevăd dispozitive de descărcare:

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Only manual discharge fails specific switched-step low voltage capacitor bank provision.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Automatically activated discharge devices expressly required for step-switchable fractional banks.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: General bank devices may be manual OR automatic, but switchable stepped banks are a stricter exception requiring automatic.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Prior §7.21.11 addresses capacitor bank short-circuit design; following §7.21.13 addresses capacitor bank rooms/physical surroundings.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Difference between generic capacitor-bank discharge and step-switched capacitor banks, time ≤1min and residual voltage <42V.

cases.verbatim_question: Condensatoarele legate direct la bornele receptoarelor de joasă tensiune:

verbatim_A_B_C.A: nu se prevăd cu dispozitive speciale de descărcare
verbatim_A_B_C.B: se prevăd cu dispozitive speciale de descărcare
verbatim_A_B_C.C: se prevăd cu dispozitive speciale de descărcare în anumite situații

reasoning_A_B_C.A: Exact explicit exception: capacitors directly connected to receiver terminals need no special discharge devices.
reasoning_A_B_C.B: Would impose devices expressly excluded by the direct-connected-receiver exception.
reasoning_A_B_C.C: The original rule's explicit exception is unqualified for the named case; this vague conditional claim is not the source rule.

normative_source.name: User I7 2011 consolidated to 2023-09-22
normative_source.context_before_and_after: Prior same paragraph discusses generic automatic/manual discharge and stricter switchable banks; subsequent §7.21.13 concerns installation locations.

cases.critical_scope_qualifier: Distinguish capacitors directly on receiver terminals from separate automatic step-switching compensation banks.
